meta.title: Private secret input
meta.description: Request credentials through a private form, returning only their reference to the agent.

ui.title: Private secret input
ui.privacy: This value goes to the host credential store, not into the chat.
ui.oneUse: This value is stored once and the agent only ever receives a reference to it.
ui.fileNote: This value is written to a private file for this command only.
ui.expiredHint: Ask the agent to send the request again.
ui.replace: Saving replaces the existing credential at this reference:
ui.error: Could not confirm the save. The value was cleared. Check the connection and credential store before retrying.
